title: Conjecture on the smallest positive zero of the transformed polynomial \widetilde\Xi_n
statement:
Let $(\Lambda_n)_{n\ge1}$ be the family of polynomials defined by the paper's explicit-polynomial construction, and set

$$
\widetilde\Xi_n(x):=\Xi_n(\sqrt{x}).
$$

For each $n$, let $0<\beta_n<1$ denote the smallest positive zero of $\widetilde\Xi_n$. **Smallest-zero conjecture.** One has

$$
\beta_n\longrightarrow 0\qquad(n\to\infty).
$$

This asserts that the smallest positive zero of the transformed polynomial approaches the origin as the index grows. The supplied context contains a proof of the stated limit, but does not identify an external resolution; the parser marks the status as unknown.
